title: Relational time: conditional states of a stationary global state relative to a ring clock

key_results.statement: Booking-independent split: $C_R:=N^{-1}\operatorname{Tr}_K(C-C_K\otimes\mathbb 1_R)$, $C_\partial:=C-C_K\otimes\mathbb 1_R-\mathbb 1_K\otimes C_R$, the unique split with $\operatorname{Tr}_KC_\partial=0$; it depends only on the total $C$, not on the booking of single-object terms.
All reading statistics are $\lambda$-independent iff $\langle K\vert\rho_\omega\vert K\rangle=0$ for every joint place $K$ and every Bohr frequency $\omega\neq0$.

Eigenvectors of $C$ suffice but are not necessary: $\lvert f_0\rangle\otimes(\alpha\lvert r_1\rangle+\beta\lvert r_2\rangle)$ with $e_{r_1}\neq e_{r_2}$, $\alpha\beta\neq0$, has constant place statistics but is not an eigenvector.

For $\lambda$-independent starts, a specified reading on $R$ has $m$-dependent $p(r\vert m)$ iff at least one class sum $\sum_{r'\in S_r}p_{(m,r')}/p(m)$ depends on $m$; some reading on $R$ has $m$-dependent statistics iff the joint place distribution of $K$ and $R$ is not a product.

Eigenvector $\Psi_{\rm ex}=(\lvert f_1\rangle\lvert+\rangle+\lvert f_0\rangle\lvert-\rangle)/\sqrt2$ with $p(0_R\vert m)=\cos^2(\pi m/N)$: the clock outcome changes the statistics of the place reading on $R$.
$Q_s\Phi(m)=0$ for $s\notin S_E$ and $Q_s\Phi(m)=e^{2\pi ik_sm/N}Q_s\Phi(0)$ for $s\in S_E$; a component can be nonzero only if $E-e_s\in\frac{2\pi}{N\lambda_0}\{0,\dots,N-1\}$.
An admissible eigenvector with eigenvalue $E$ and $\Phi(0)\propto\chi$ exists iff $\chi\in\bigoplus_{s\in S_E}Q_s\mathcal H_R$; it is then unique up to the common phase.
Conditional statistics on $R$ equal those of $e^{-iC_R\lambda}\chi$ at $\lambda=m\lambda_0$: $P_r(m)=p_r(m\lambda_0)$ for every reading on $R$.
Coincidence set $\Lambda_m\supseteq m\lambda_0+(N\lambda_0/g_\chi)\mathbb Z\supseteq m\lambda_0+N\lambda_0\mathbb Z$; the middle set is exactly where the states coincide.
If $e^{-iC\lambda_0}=S\otimes W$ with $W$ unitary on $\mathcal H_R$, then $\Phi(m+1)=U\Phi(m)$ with $U=e^{iE\lambda_0}W$ for every eigenvector.

(3.14) holds for $C_\partial=\sum_k\lvert f_k\rangle\langle f_k\rvert\otimes B_k$ with $B_k=B_k^\dagger$ and $e^{-i(C_R+B_k)\lambda_0}=W$ for all $k$ (with $\sum_kB_k=0$ in the split (3.19), no restriction).

For $N=2$, $C_R=0$, $C_\partial=gZ\otimes\lvert0\rangle\langle0\rvert_R$, $g\neq0$, an eigenvector has $\lVert\Phi(0)\rVert^2=p_+\neq p_-=\lVert\Phi(1)\rVert^2$, so no unitary $U$ with $\Phi(m+1)=U\Phi(m)$ exists.
Clock time of the reading $m$: $\tau_m:=m\lambda_0$ mod $N\lambda_0$.

Rates convert with factor one: $(P_r(m+1)-P_r(m))/\lambda_0=\mathrm dp_r/\mathrm d\lambda\vert_{\tau_m}+\delta$, $\lvert\delta\rvert\le\lambda_0w_\chi^2/2$, for an eigenvector with (3.14), $W\propto e^{-iC_R\lambda_0}$, and $\lambda_0w_\chi\ll1$ for the derivative form.

definitions.name: Conditional statistics and reference statistics of R alone

open_issues: Readings are place partitions, so λ-independence of all statistics (3.2) is weaker than stationarity; relational evolution for non-eigenvector starts satisfying (3.2) is not treated.
Λ_m in (3.13) is characterized only through place moduli; beyond the two inclusions no closed form is given.
Item 3 gives only a sufficient condition (3.14); a necessary and sufficient condition on C_∂ is not determined, and the realization (3.15) needs a fine-tuned spectrum of the B_k.
The conversion (3.18) is a statement on clock steps; the N samples p_r(τ_m) do not in general determine p_r between ticks; resolution belongs to criterion 1.
Superpositions of eigenvectors with different E are not treated.

consistency_checks.check: Dimensions and normalization of the place probabilities in (3.11) and (3.16)
χ an eigenvector of C_R: product eigenvector, m-independent statistics, δ = 0
N = 2 in example (3.5): shift relation (3.6) against the direct conditional state
